name: hip-flexor-lacrosse-ball
instructions:
1. Find your belly button and the point of your hip (ASIS), draw a diagonal line between the two, and then place the lacrosse ball directly in the middle of the line.
2. In a prone position, situate the lacrosse ball within the designated area and lie down.
3. Support your head with your hands and slowly roll the hip flexors for 20-30 seconds.
4. Repeat on the other side.
